name: emoji-finder
title: Emoji Finder
description: Find the right emoji by describing it. Semantic search over 1,870 emojis, powered by Upstash Redis Vector.
author: REPLACE_WITH_RAYCAST_HANDLE

commands.name: search-emojis
commands.title: Search Emojis
commands.subtitle: Emoji Finder
commands.description: Describe an emoji and paste the best match.

preferences.name: upstashRedisRestUrl
preferences.title: Upstash Redis REST URL
preferences.description: REST URL of an Upstash Redis database seeded with `npm run seed`.

preferences.name: proxyUrl
preferences.title: Search Proxy URL
preferences.description: Optional. A server that answers GET /api/search-emojis?q=&topK= and holds the keys itself. Used when the three fields above are empty.
